search_window.basis: Overlap since last confirmed watch check at approximately 03:45 PDT; current run executed with delayed schedule.

coverage_notes.primary_collector: Supplementary recall watch; production Care Line national collector remains authoritative.
coverage_notes.search_scope: U.S. states and territories; hospital/ED/maternity/behavioral/dialysis/oncology/primary-care access changes; rural emergency care, ground and air ambulance service, CMS provider actions, restorations.
coverage_notes.excluded: Prior-watch duplicates (Fitzgibbon, Gulf Coast storm-related VA closures); October 7 Townsend clinic closure predates this window and is not verified new since the prior check; prospective non-effective changes; out-of-country stories.
coverage_notes.research_result: No newly announced qualifying access changes substantiated within the observation window. Dates of search indexing are not treated as event announcement dates.
